reason: Reading view exposes only an unnamed searchbox, not the exact named Search control.
summary:
The test assumed that the Reading view would provide a search field with the exact accessible name “Search.” The available field was unnamed, and the instructions expressly said not to use an unnamed substitute.
Update the test expectation to match the intended accessible name, or have the site give the Reading-view search field the accessible name “Search.”
steps: wait: Waiting report barrier that the searchbox named “Search” does not exist in Reading view
objective: Work exclusively inside the Reading view dialog. Use only its listed roles, names and controls. Report a barrier if the exact named control does not exist; an unnamed control is not a substitute. Test the exact target and report the outcome once. Stay on this public site. Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge. Leave fixture settings unchanged. Use visible controls only. In Reading view, locate the searchbox named “Search”. Enter the text test and confirm the field contains it. Do not submit.
